notes.text: Security update for thrift
notes.title: Title of the patch

notes.text:
This update for thrift fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-41602: TFramedTransport frame size headers can lead to a uint32 integer overflow (bsc#1263557).
- CVE-2026-41604: Swift input with an invalid field range can lead to an out-of-bounds read and application crash
  (bsc#1263492).
- CVE-2026-41605: compact protocol messages with large integer values can lead to integer overflow (bsc#1263438).
- CVE-2026-41606: crafted nested messages in c_glib dispatch can lead to uncontrolled recursion and denial of service
  (bsc#1263365).
- CVE-2026-41607: crafted message with improper length validation can lead to an out-of-bounds read and potential
  information disclosure (bsc#1263321).
- CVE-2026-41608: Unbounded Zlib Decompression in Python THeaderTransport (bsc#1272609).
- CVE-2026-41636: uncontrolled recursion in Node.js bindings can lead to denial of service via stack exhaustion
  (bsc#1263322).
- CVE-2026-43871: TCompactProtocol varint byte-count limit (bsc#1272648).
- CVE-2026-45112: Unbounded Read Leading to Denial of Service (bsc#1272647).
- CVE-2026-48144: c_glib TLS Client Missing Hostname Verification (bsc#1272645).
- CVE-2026-48145: C++ TSSLSocket matchName() RFC 6125 Wildcard Bypass (bsc#1272658).
- CVE-2026-48586: TZlibTransport Decompression Size Limit (bsc#1272657).
- CVE-2026-49158: Ruby THeaderTransport ZLIB Decompression Bomb (bsc#1272656).
- CVE-2026-55968: Node.js quadratic-time DoS in server receive transports (bsc#1272650).
- CVE-2026-55969: integer overflow in TProtocol:checkReadBytesAvailable() (bsc#1272649).
- CVE-2026-55970: C++ heap out-of-bounds read in THeaderTransport:readHeaderFormat() (bsc#1272655).
- CVE-2026-55971: C++ ZLIB heap buffer overflow (write) in THeaderTransport:untransform() (bsc#1272653).
- CVE-2026-58023: c_glib heap out-of-bounds read in transport leftover-bytes path (bsc#1272654).
- CVE-2026-58389: Rust binary protocol non-strict path missing string size limit (bsc#1272652).
- CVE-2026-58662: C++ THeaderTransport:readString() info-header length bounds bypass (bsc#1272651).
- CVE-2026-82458: allocation of resources without limits or throttling in several bindings (bsc#1284076).
- CVE-2026-82459: integer underflow leading to out-of-bounds write in C++ 32 bit THeaderTransport (bsc#1284077).
- CVE-2026-85086: improper certificate validation and initialization of resource with insecure default in Perl bindings
  (bsc#1284078).
- CVE-2026-85483: use of uninitialized resource and return of wrong status code in c_glib bindings (bsc#1284102).
- CVE-2026-85493: uncontrolled recursion in Dart and Java ME bindings (bsc#1284101).
- CVE-2026-85494: improper handling of length parameter, uncaught exception, inefficient algorithm complexity, improper
  memory allocation and improper initialization of resources in several bindings (bsc#1284079).
- CVE-2026-86537: uncaught exception, infinite loop and integer underflow in D language bindings (bsc#1284123).
- CVE-2026-91135: heap-based buffer overflow in C++ THeaderTransport (bsc#1284100).
- CVE-2026-91137: improper validation of specified quantity in input leading to allocation of resources without limits
  or throttling in PHP bindings (bsc#1284080).
- CVE-2026-93925: stack-based buffer overflow in the C++ THeaderProtocol (bsc#1284093).
- CVE-2026-93926: missing release of memory after effective lifetime in THeaderTransport (bsc#1284092).
- CVE-2026-94633: improper handling of length parameters and memory allocation with excessive size value in Dart
  bindings (bsc#1284091).
- CVE-2026-94634: allocation of resources without limits or throttling and initialization of resource with insecure
  default in Python bindings (bsc#1284099).
- CVE-2026-94635: imṕroper handling of length parameter and allocation of resources without limits or throttling in Lua
  bindings (bsc#1284090).
- CVE-2026-94639: improper handling of exceptional conditions, allocation of resources without limits or throttling and
  uncaught exception in Java bindings (bsc#1284098).
- CVE-2026-94642: uncaught exception in PHP bindings (bsc#1284081).
- CVE-2026-94644: allocation of resources without limits or throttling in PHP bindings (bsc#1284097).
- CVE-2026-94645: improper validation of specified quantity in input leading to allocation of resources without limits
  or throttling in nodejs bindings (bsc#1284096).
- CVE-2026-94650: uncontrolled recursion in c_glib bindings (bsc#1284082).
- CVE-2026-94651: improper handling of exceptional conditions and no release of resource after effective lifetime in
  Java bindings (bsc#1284095).
- CVE-2026-94653: inefficient algorithm complexity in PHP bindings (bsc#1284122).
- CVE-2026-94654: infinite loop in Python bindings (bsc#1284121).
- CVE-2026-94655: allocation of resources without limits or throttling and inefficient algorithm complexity in Lua
  bindings (bsc#1284120).
- CVE-2026-94656: alocation of resources without limits or throttling in Ruby bindings (bsc#1284119).
- CVE-2026-94657: alocation of resources without limits or throttling in JavaME bindings (bsc#1284118).
- CVE-2026-94658: inefficient algorithm complexity in Lua bindings (bsc#1284117).
- CVE-2026-96277: uncaught exception and improper handling of exceptional conditions in Ruby bindings (bsc#1284116).
- CVE-2026-96286: uncaught exception in Perl bindings (bsc#1284115).
- CVE-2026-96287: inefficient algorithm complexity in Perl bindings (bsc#1284114).
- CVE-2026-96288: uncontrolled recursion and allocation of resources without limits or throttling in Erlang bindings
  (bsc#1284113).
- CVE-2026-96289: uncontrolled recursion in PHP bindings (bsc#1284112).
- CVE-2026-96292: inefficient regular expression and algorithm complexity in Lua bindings (bsc#1284111).
- CVE-2026-96990: allocation of resources without limits or throttling in Erlang bindings (bsc#1284094).

Changes for thrift:

- Update to 0.25.0:
 * CVE-2026-93925: stack-based buffer overflow in the C++ varint
 writer, reached through THeaderProtocol frames (boo#1284093)
 * CVE-2026-91135: heap-based buffer overflow when the ZLIB transform
 is enabled on C++ THeaderTransport frames (boo#1284100)
 * CVE-2026-82459: integer underflow in the 32-bit C++
 THeaderTransport frame size leads to an out-of-bounds write
 (boo#1284077)
 * CVE-2026-93926: memory not released after its effective lifetime in
 THeaderTransport (boo#1284092)
 * CVE-2026-82458: allocation of resources without limits in the C++
 protocol reader (boo#1284076)
 * CVE-2026-85086: the Perl SSLSocket defaulted to SSL_VERIFY_NONE,
 leaving TLS unauthenticated (boo#1284078)
 * CVE-2026-85494: improper length handling and uncaught exceptions in
 the Python, Perl and PHP bindings (boo#1284079)
 * CVE-2026-91137: unvalidated quantity in PHP input causes unbounded
 allocation (boo#1284080)
 * CVE-2026-94642: uncaught exception in the PHP bindings
 (boo#1284081)
 * CVE-2026-94644: allocation of resources without limits in the PHP
 bindings (boo#1284097)
 * CVE-2026-94634: unbounded allocation and insecure default
 initialization in the Python bindings (boo#1284099)
 * CVE-2026-94650: uncontrolled recursion in the c_glib protocol
 reader (boo#1284082)
 * CVE-2026-85483: use of an uninitialized resource and a wrong status
 code in the c_glib bindings (boo#1284102)
 * CVE-2026-96289: uncontrolled recursion in the PHP bindings
 (boo#1284112)
 * CVE-2026-94653: inefficient algorithm complexity in the PHP bindings
 (boo#1284122)
 * CVE-2026-96287: inefficient algorithm complexity in the Perl
 bindings (boo#1284114)
 * CVE-2026-96286: uncaught exception in the Perl bindings
 (boo#1284115)
 * CVE-2026-94654: loop with an unreachable exit condition in the
 Python bindings (boo#1284121)
 * The remaining CVEs fixed by this release affect bindings this
 package does not build and are therefore not affected here:
 CVE-2026-85493 (boo#1284101, Dart and Java ME)
 CVE-2026-94635 (boo#1284090, Lua)
 CVE-2026-94633 (boo#1284091, Dart)
 CVE-2026-96990 (boo#1284094, Erlang)
 CVE-2026-94651 (boo#1284095, Java)
 CVE-2026-94645 (boo#1284096, node.js)
 CVE-2026-94639 (boo#1284098, Java)
 CVE-2026-96292 (boo#1284111, Lua)
 CVE-2026-96288 (boo#1284113, Erlang)
 CVE-2026-96277 (boo#1284116, Ruby)
 CVE-2026-94658 (boo#1284117, Lua)
 CVE-2026-94657 (boo#1284118, Java ME)
 CVE-2026-94656 (boo#1284119, Ruby)
 CVE-2026-94655 (boo#1284120, Lua)
 CVE-2026-86537 (boo#1284123, D).
- Build the bindings as _multibuild flavors of this one spec
 (@BUILD_FLAVOR@): perl, python and the new php. None links the
 C++ core, so they no longer extend its critical path. Each
 flavor needs its own Name: to keep its src and debug packages
 from colliding with the core's; the new thrift-rpmlintrc zeroes
 the resulting invalid-spec-name badness.
- New package php8-thrift: the Thrift\ class library plus the
 thrift_protocol accelerator extension.
- Fix the 15.x build, which failed everywhere: the
 suse_version >= 1550 guard forced Python 3.6. Use
 %{?sle15_python_module_pythons}, renaming the 15.x binary to
 python311-thrift. Add BuildRequires: gcc-c++, without which
 setup.py silently drops the fastbinary accelerator.
- Stop installing the Perl bindings twice - upstream's
 INSTALL_BASE=/usr/local overrode INSTALLDIRS=vendor. Drive
 Makefile.PL directly, dropping the bogus "mv
 %{_perl_vendorlib}" workaround. perl-thrift is now noarch and
 requires perl(Bit::Vector), without which
 Thrift::BinaryProtocol failed.
- Split libthrift_c_glib-devel out of libthrift-devel; a
 pkgconfig/*.pc glob had put all four .pc files in one package.
- Pin the library %files to %{version} instead of globbing
 libthrift-*.so, and assert %{libversion} in %build so a missed
 bump is an FTBFS.
- Add %check to every binding flavor. The C++ suite stays
 disabled - it needs a static Boost, which openSUSE lacks.
- Drop the dead java, ruby and qt5 bconds and the c bcond
 (default-on, so it only ever served to break the shipped
 libthrift_c_glib0), Conflicts: libthrift-0_11_0, %define
 oldpython and the backports.ssl_match_hostname Recommends;
 raise the Suggests floors to setup.py's tornado >= 6.3.0 and
 Twisted >= 24.3.0.
- Add License: and %license to every subpackage, switch to
 %ldconfig_scriptlets and %make_build, drop Group tags, the
 CXXFLAGS export and the redundant %make_install re-runs.
- Use rpmlint filter instead of setBadness

notes.text:
Integer Overflow or Wraparound vulnerability in Apache Thrift TFramedTransport Go language implementation

This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.23.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.23.0, which fixes the issue.

notes.text:
Heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache Thrift C++ THeaderTransport.



When an application enables the ZLIB transform for the frames it sends, THeaderTransport::transform() copies the compressed frame into the write buffer without making sure it fits. Data that does not compress, such as content a remote peer supplied, grows under compression, so the copy writes past the end of the heap buffer by an amount that grows with the size of the frame, and for large frames it also reads past the end of the transform buffer.



This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.25.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.25.0, which fixes the issue.
